scripts.dev:all: pnpm --filter proovra-web dev & pnpm --filter proovra-mobile dev
scripts._dev_stack_notes: Phase CAPTURE-ARTIFACT-PIPELINE — the report worker is a SEPARATE process. Without it every Capture hangs at SIGNED forever because nothing consumes the BullMQ `report` queue (no Report/VerificationPackage row is ever created). `pnpm dev` (below) starts API + worker + web concurrently using pnpm's built-in --parallel runner. Use dev:api / dev:worker / dev:web for individual processes.
scripts.dev: pnpm --parallel --filter proovra-api --filter proovra-worker --filter proovra-web run dev
scripts.build:shared: pnpm run prisma:generate && pnpm --filter @proovra/shared build && pnpm --filter @proovra/shared-evidence-presentation build && pnpm --filter @proovra/shared-billing build && pnpm --filter @proovra/shared-runtime build && pnpm --filter @proovra/ui build
scripts.build:web: pnpm run build:shared && pnpm --filter proovra-web build
scripts.build:api: pnpm run build:shared && pnpm --filter proovra-api build
scripts.build:worker: pnpm run build:shared && pnpm --filter proovra-worker build
scripts._audit_notes: PHASE 0 — `audit:architecture` is the ONE current-audit command. Default regenerates every current artifact then checks the engine. `--engine-check` asks whether the measuring instrument is sound and exits 0 even while product work is open. `--closure-check` asks whether the PRODUCT is closed and exits non-zero while it is not. Keeping those apart is deliberate: a permanent red that means 'open work' teaches everyone to ignore a red that means 'every number here is a guess'. FUTURE-AUDIT RULE: a finding may only be reported as current if proven from source/tests/runtime/browser evidence at the pinned audit SHA; prior reports are leads for revalidation only, never evidence, and never copied into a new findings register; generated audit evidence must not be imported into runtime or product architecture. audit-output/ holds only engine-generated artifacts; historical audits live in git history only.
